paper: SAGE: SLO-Aware Adaptive Retrieval for Production RAG Systems

feature_descriptions.query_length_chars: Character count of the raw input query
feature_descriptions.query_avg_word_len: Average character length per word in query
feature_descriptions.top1_score: Highest RRF / probe score from initial retrieval
feature_descriptions.score_drop: Score difference between top-1 and top-2 probe candidates (s1 - s2)
feature_descriptions.score_mean: Arithmetic mean of top probe candidate retrieval scores
feature_descriptions.score_std: Standard deviation of top probe candidate retrieval scores
feature_descriptions.sparse_dense_agreement: Jaccard overlap coefficient between top BM25 and top Dense candidates
feature_descriptions.target_slo_ms: Target latency Service Level Objective deadline in milliseconds
